about_short_description.short_description: Interfaze develops AI APIs for OCR, web scraping, speech recognition, classification, and structured data extraction workflows.

product.name: AI Web Scraper
product.description: An API-driven tool that extracts structured data from dynamic websites using natural language prompts without requiring CSS selectors.

product.name: AI Summary API
product.description: An API that generates controlled, structured text summaries from large documents or texts with adjustable detail and context.

product.name: AI Prediction API
product.description: A zero-shot time series forecasting API that predicts future data points without prior training on the dataset.

product.name: Speech to Text API
product.description: An API that transcribes audio and video content into text in over 100 languages using AI models.

product.name: vOCR API
product.description: An AI-powered optical character recognition API that extracts structured text data from images and documents with high accuracy.
